'''The Goose and Crown''' is an inn located in a village east of [[Carysford]] and about a day's ride from [[Caemlyn]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Goose and Crown, The}} [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Mat Cauthon]] approached the inn, but then hid when they saw the [[Raimun Holdwin|innkeeper]] talking to a [[Myrddraal]]. They were then offered a lift into Caemlyn by cart-driver [[Almen Bunt]].
